meta.name: Kasargod Embassy
meta.description: Azi and Chemmu, cousins trapped in poverty in late 2000s Kasaragod, work for their cunning uncle Razak Mama, whose stationery shop hides a forgery racket.

videos.title: Sleepless Nights Ahead
videos.overview: A plane crash in Mangalore pushes the nation into a state of emergency. On the other hand, the dark and interconnected lives of Azi and Chemmu take shape in the shadows.

videos.title: Warm Up
videos.overview: Azi and Chemmu are recruited by a mysterious man named Roy, who helps them grow their forgery business, just as they come out of prison. Meanwhile, the NBI searches for the culprits behind the crash.

videos.title: Product Approved
videos.overview: Under Roy’s mentorship, the cousins master the art of passport forgery, getting high-profile clients. Later, when a rookie mistake exposes their game, it opens the door to the criminal underworld.

videos.title: The Trap
videos.overview: Azi and Chemmu work tirelessly under Dammanna, but their newfound wealth pushes Razak Mama to ask for a seat at the table. On the other hand, the NIA gets closer to Dammanna.

videos.title: Upgrade and Disruption
videos.overview: A high-end client leads the cousins to Dammanna, the kingpin of counterfeiting, who upgrades their street-level setup to a high-tech fortress. However, the larger their business, the higher the risks.

videos.title: House of Cards
videos.overview: The NBI strikes gold as they capture Roy, sending Dammanna into a frenzied burn-notice operation to erase all evidence. Meanwhile, the lives of the boys are left dangling amidst a national crisis.

videos.title: Two Separate Ways
videos.overview: Dammanna outsmarts his rivals and vanishes into thin air. Vivek realises that he has been chasing shadows, while Azi and Chemmu are left to deal with the remains of a dismantled empire.
